# SQLAlchemy vs Django ORM

**Provenance**: benchmark ground-truth answer, generated by chroma_kb/populate_benchmark_kb.py from benchmarks/cases_200.json; evaluation material, not a research source.

**Category**: Backend Frameworks & API
**Expected winner**: SQLAlchemy

## Analysis

SQLAlchemy can be used standalone and has richer query capabilities, relationship handling, and async support (v2.0+). Django ORM is tightly coupled to Django and can't easily be used outside it.
